personal.name: Youssef Mohamed Abd El-Fattah
personal.headline: .NET Backend Engineer & DevOps Practitioner
personal.bio: .NET Backend Developer specializing in building scalable RESTful APIs with ASP.NET Core and distributed .NET microservices. Experienced in Clean Architecture, CQRS, and design patterns, with strong testing practices using xUnit and Moq. Passionate about DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

status.text: Open for Full-time Roles & High-Impact Engineering Opportunities

story: I am a .NET Backend Engineer and DevOps practitioner studying Computer Engineering at Benha University (Class of 2027) with an Excellent grade (92%).

My engineering journey is driven by designing resilient, scalable backend ecosystems. I architect and deliver complex distributed systems—ranging from high-performance Modular Monoliths with MediatR and Transactional Outbox, to polyglot microservices systems with YARP/Ocelot API gateways, RabbitMQ event-driven messaging, and Kubernetes orchestration.

Through intensive hands-on programs at the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI), the Information Technology Institute (ITI), and Route Academy, I bridge the gap between software development and cloud operations with automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code.

projects.title: eshop-modulith — Modular Monolith eCommerce
projects.tagline: Modular Monolith eCommerce engine with in-process MediatR & Transactional Outbox.
projects.description: Engineered eshop-modulith as an isolated modular monolith containing Catalog, Basket, and Ordering modules sharing a single PostgreSQL instance with per-module schemas.
projects.fullDescription: Built the eCommerce domain as an isolated modular monolith to learn direct architectural trade-offs against microservices. Modules communicate in-process via MediatR and leverage the Transactional Outbox pattern to reliably publish cross-module domain events without distributed transaction overhead.
keyFeatures: Isolated modules (Catalog, Basket, Ordering) with per-module PostgreSQL schemas
In-process asynchronous messaging using MediatR
Transactional Outbox pattern ensuring 100% reliable domain event delivery
Clean Domain-Driven Design (DDD) with rich aggregate roots

projects.title: eshop-microservices — Distributed Event-Driven Architecture
projects.tagline: 4 independently deployable services behind YARP API Gateway with RabbitMQ & gRPC.
projects.description: Complete microservices ecosystem with Catalog, Basket, Discount, and Ordering services, polyglot persistence, RabbitMQ async events, and gRPC communication.
projects.fullDescription: 4 independently deployable microservices (Catalog, Basket, Discount, Ordering) configured behind a YARP API Gateway. Features polyglot persistence (Marten/PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite), asynchronous event-driven communication via RabbitMQ, and high-performance gRPC synchronous service invocations.
keyFeatures: YARP (Yet Another Reverse Proxy) API Gateway routing and rate limiting
Polyglot persistence: Marten/PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and SQLite
Event-driven architecture with RabbitMQ and MassTransit
High-performance inter-service communication with gRPC

projects.title: eCommerce Microservices on Kubernetes (AKS)
projects.tagline: 5-repository enterprise microservices suite deployed to Kubernetes with CI/CD.
projects.description: Built a 5-repository microservices eCommerce system (Users, Products, Orders, API Gateway, Infrastructure) with polyglot persistence, Ocelot Gateway, and automated CI/CD.
projects.fullDescription: Enterprise 5-repository microservices architecture featuring polyglot persistence (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB), an Ocelot API Gateway, RabbitMQ event-driven cache invalidation, Redis distributed caching, and Polly resilience policies (Retry, Circuit Breaker). Fully containerized and deployed to Kubernetes with automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
keyFeatures: 5 separate repositories (Users API, Products API, Orders API, Gateway, Infrastructure)
Ocelot API Gateway with JWT claims delegation
RabbitMQ event-driven Redis cache invalidation
Automated deployment to Kubernetes (Minikube / AKS) via GitHub Actions

projects.title: Clean Architecture Web API & Azure Services
projects.tagline: Production-ready ASP.NET Core 8 Web API boilerplate with Azure cloud integration.
projects.description: Scalable enterprise Web API implementing Clean Architecture, CQRS, MediatR, FluentValidation, JWT authentication, and Azure cloud services integration.
projects.fullDescription: A robust, production-tested boilerplate designed to accelerate enterprise backend development. Follows strict Clean Architecture layer separation, CQRS with MediatR, FluentValidation pipeline behaviors, structured logging with Serilog, and seamless Azure Cloud services integration.
keyFeatures: Strict Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layer separation
CQRS pattern with MediatR request and notification handlers
Comprehensive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation with JWT bearer support
Azure Services integration and cloud deployment readiness

projects.title: HR Leave Management Enterprise API
projects.tagline: Role-based HR leave management system with automated approvals and unit testing.
projects.description: Complete enterprise HR API featuring role-based authorization, leave allocation workflows, email notification triggers, and comprehensive unit tests with xUnit and Moq.
projects.fullDescription: Enterprise human resources platform automating employee leave allocations and approvals. Built using ASP.NET Core and Clean Architecture with comprehensive unit test coverage utilizing xUnit, Moq, AutoFixture, and FluentAssertions to ensure zero-regression releases.
keyFeatures: Role-based authorization for Employees and HR Managers
Automated leave request review and approval workflows
Comprehensive unit tests using xUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions
Transactional email alerts for leave status updates

projects.title: eCommerce API (Onion Architecture & Stripe)
projects.tagline: RESTful API with Repository Pattern, Unit of Work, Redis cache, and Stripe payments.
projects.description: Robust eCommerce backend built with Onion Architecture, Generic Repository pattern, Unit of Work, Redis distributed caching, and Stripe payment gateway.
projects.fullDescription: Built during the Route Academy Diploma, this high-performance eCommerce API leverages Onion Architecture to isolate core business rules from external dependencies. Features include Redis caching for catalog queries, Stripe checkout integration, specification pattern querying, and JWT authentication.
keyFeatures: Generic Repository and Unit of Work patterns for clean data access
Redis in-memory caching to boost product catalog performance
Stripe payment gateway integration with webhook listeners
Specification pattern for dynamic filtering, sorting, and pagination
